mechanism_relevant_findings: Phosphate glasses can conduct protons via strong hydrogen bonding interactions.
Protons in phosphate glasses form much stronger hydrogen bonds compared to those in silicate glasses.
limitations: Long-term stability of proton conductivity is problematic and relies on maintaining high humidity.

relevance_judgement.reason: The paper extensively discusses proton transport mechanisms in phosphate glasses.
